shortDescription: User profile overview view with GitHub-style dark desktop layout.
fullDescription: Renders the user-profile-overview view in its default state with a gradient top header, profile navigation tabs, left identity sidebar, popular repositories grid, contribution heatmap, year selector, and contribution activity section. The view exposes a state prop, keeps profile tabs selectable, preserves search input text locally, and wires the contribution settings select and year buttons for immediate presentational interaction.
